contexts.text: They love only... to debate, not what they are, but whether they are; and, so long as they are in this state, they will not know anything whatever about these innumerable things. AC 3747:end.
They who are in the Celestial Kingdom... never have any debate about truths; so much so, that when the conversation turns to the subject of truths, they merely say, It is so, or, It is not so...
To sue at the law, and to want to take away the coat = to debate about truths, and to want to persuade that they are not true.

The gnashing of teeth is the continual debate and combat of falsities together, thus of those who are in falsities, conjoined with contempt for others, enmity, mockery, ridicule, reviling... These debates and combats are heard outside those Hells as gnashings of teeth; and are also turned into gnashings of teeth when truths from Heaven flow in thither... All the fallacies of the senses are truths to them, and it is from these that they debate. This is the reason why their debates are heard as gnashings of teeth...

I once heard as it were the gnashing of teeth... The Angels said, They are schools... where they debate together. These debates are heard thus at a distance; but when near, only as debates. Described. TCR 460.
(A debate in the Spiritual World on the subject, Why does not God impute the merit of His Son to everybody.)
Among the ancients it was... debated which of the two must be first, (charity or faith).
